title: Lang Design Ceramic Striped Pumpkin Mug, Halloween - Used
descriptionText:
This Lang Design ceramic mug is perfect for Halloween with its yellow and green striped design, featuring a painted pumpkin pattern. It has a 16oz capacity and is suitable for hot or cold beverages. The round shape and modern style make it a great addition to any collection.

This one-piece mug is an original Lang Design product, manufactured in 2022 in China. It is suitable for teens, boys, girls, and unisex adults and kids. The mug is decorated with a food and drink theme, and its stock number is BB01B07014-0722. This mug is a must-have for anyone who loves pumpkins and wants to add a unique piece to their collection.
